comparison.objective: Lever a door upward and insert a packer so the door rests on it.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a pry bar while sliding and aligning a shim under load.
comparison.success_condition: Required lift achieved, packer seated, door resting and still, hands released.
comparison.reason: Tests load lifting and under-load insertion; it does not test rotary calibration, locking torque, or repeated impact-response convergence.
